reader.requirement: At --std 85 a program with the COMMON clause, directly contained in program P, may be called by P and by any program directly or indirectly contained in P, except the common program itself and programs contained within it (§1985:X.1.3.8.1 SR2); a program outside P cannot reach it; RECURSIVE does not exist at 85 so the exception always applies.

edition-consulted.switches: PROGRAM-ID ... RECURSIVE refused below 2002 (ProgramIdRecursive2002), so CommonProgramReferable's commonIsRecursive escape is unreachable at 85

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|IsActive|DialectLevel in ProgramTable.ResolveVisible, ProgramNameScope, BinderDriver.NestedCallablesOf: none; the scope walk is the same code at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: same resolver; at 85 only the RECURSIVE attribute (2002) is unavailable
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers a sibling and an indirectly contained caller; not exercised: the exception (the common program itself and its own containees), a caller outside the containing program, two common siblings

probes.printed: C RUNS / K: C NOT VISIBLE / K: D NOT VISIBLE / B RUNS / D RUNS / C RUNS ... / E: C CALLED / D: B NOT VISIBLE / X RUNS / X: C NOT VISIBLE
probes.expected: C reachable from A and from E (inside B/D); not from K (inside C) nor from separately compiled X; non-common B not from its containee D (§1985:X.1.3.8.1 SR1, SR2)

probes.printed: QC2 RUNS / QC RUNS 1 / QC: SELF NOT VISIBLE (same at --std 2023)
probes.expected: a common sibling calls another common program; the common program cannot reference its own name

probes.printed: error COBOL0887: program 'RA': COMMON may be specified only in a CONTAINED program
error COBOL0885: PROGRAM-ID RECURSIVE requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.3.1.4 GR2  (cite.py --check "may be called from programs other than that containing it")
OK  §1985:X.1.3.8.1 SR2  (cite.py --check "except that program possessing the common attribute and any programs contained within it")

reader.notes: ResolveVisible walks the caller's ancestors and admits a COMMON child of each unless ProgramNameScope says the caller is (in) the common program; BinderDriver.NestedCallablesOf uses the same predicate at bind time. COBOL0887 cites §2023:11.10.3 SR4 at --std 85 (label only).

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 aimed where the reader's did not go. refute-1985-04/c3/r3.cob: CALL identifier (value 'QC') from sibling QB reaches common QC (B: QC BY ID CALLED); CANCEL 'QC' and CANCEL identifier from the sibling reach it too (CNT back to 1 after each, X.1.3.8.1 names CANCEL as a program-name reference); 'IS INITIAL COMMON PROGRAM' gives CNT=1 on every call; a common program QG directly contained in QB is reachable from QD inside QB but NOT from QB's sibling QF (literal and identifier) nor from the outer QA (SR2: only the program that directly contains it and that program's containees). refute-1985-04/c3/r3b.cob: every form of the 1985 format's {COMMON|INITIAL} choice (bare 'COMMON', 'IS COMMON INITIAL PROGRAM', 'INITIAL COMMON', 'COMMON PROGRAM') is accepted and the program is common. r3c.cob: the 2002 AS phrase on a common program is refused at 85 (COBOL0900). cite.py: OK §1985:X.3.1.4 GR2 ('may be called from programs other than that containing it'); OK §1985:X.1.3.8.1 SR2 ('except that program possessing the common attribute and any programs contained within it'); OK §1985:X.1.3.8.1 ('A program-name may be referenced only by the CALL statement, the CANCEL statement'). Not probed, the text being silent: a common program and a separately compiled program of the same name (1985 states no precedence). Label-only: COBOL1795/COBOL0900 cite §2023 clauses at --std 85.
